mapper.insert: INSERT INTO SCHED_TRANSFORM_RESULT ( TRANSFORM_TASK_ID, RESULT_DATA, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{transformTaskId}, CAST(#{resultData} AS JSONB), CURRENT_TIMESTAMP )
mapper.select: SELECT R.TRANSFORM_RESULT_ID, R.TRANSFORM_TASK_ID, T.RAW_DATA_ID, D.EXTERNAL_API_ID, A.API_NAME, V.TRANSFORM_RULE_ID, U.RULE_NAME, V.VERSION_NO, V.DATA_FORMAT, CAST(R.RESULT_DATA AS VARCHAR) AS RESULT_DATA, R.CREATED_AT FROM SCHED_TRANSFORM_RESULT R INNER JOIN SCHED_TRANSFORM_TASK T ON R.TRANSFORM_TASK_ID = T.TRANSFORM_TASK_ID INNER JOIN SCHED_COLLECT_RAW_DATA D ON T.RAW_DATA_ID = D.RAW_DATA_ID INNER JOIN SCHED_EXTERNAL_API A ON D.EXTERNAL_API_ID = A.EXTERNAL_API_ID INNER JOIN SCHED_TRANSFORM_RULE_VERSION V ON T.TRANSFORM_RULE_VERSION_ID = V.TRANSFORM_RULE_VERSION_ID INNER JOIN SCHED_TRANSFORM_RULE U ON V.TRANSFORM_RULE_ID = U.TRANSFORM_RULE_ID WHERE R.TRANSFORM_RESULT_ID = #{transformResultId}
